utterances.speaker: Person 1
utterances.text: Good morning. Today's agenda item is the mobile release and the login bug.

utterances.speaker: Person 2
utterances.text: The login bug affects about five percent of Android users.

utterances.speaker: Person 1
utterances.text: Then we agreed the fix goes out before the release, not after.

utterances.speaker: Person 2
utterances.text: I will fix the login bug by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Person 3
utterances.text: Should we also update the privacy policy screen?

utterances.speaker: Person 1
utterances.text: Let's decide that next week. For now we decided to ship version 2.4 on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Person 3
utterances.text: I will prepare the release notes by Thursday EOD.

decisions.text: Ship the login fix before the release

action_items.task: Fix the login bug by Wednesday
Prepare the release notes by Thursday EOD
